resources.string: You’re on Free: Levels 1–3 with ads and 3 saved or custom days, all in Favorites.
You have Plus: Levels 1–5, no ads, 30 saved or custom days in up to 3 lists of 10, your own level names and parks near you.
You have Pro: everything in Plus, Levels 6 to 10, 300 saved or custom days in up to 10 lists of 30, the leaderboard, and your progress saved to your Google account.
